title: Run! Bees!
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 12. Human VOA audio; WorldVoice provides only a selected, bilingual transcript excerpt; read the full conversation on the credited official page. No sentence timings have been verified. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Wow. Did you know that bees are dying?
dialogue.translation_ar: واو. هل تعلم أن النحل يموت؟

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.text: That is bad news. If all the bees died, there would be no food. Bees are very important.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذا خبر سيئ. لو مات كل النحل فلن يكون هناك طعام. النحل مهم جدًا.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Yes, they are. Speaking of bees, one of our little friends is here now.
dialogue.translation_ar: صحيح. وبما أننا نتحدث عن النحل، ها قد جاء أحد أصدقائنا الصغار.

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.text: You know, Anna, if you ignore it, it will fly away. But if you swat it, it might sting you.
dialogue.translation_ar: تعلمين يا آنا، إن تجاهلتِ النحلة فستطير بعيدًا، لكن إن حاولتِ ضربها فقد تلدغك.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I’ll ignore it. I can ignore it. See, I’m ignoring it.
dialogue.translation_ar: سأتجاهلها. أستطيع تجاهلها. أرأيت؟ أنا أتجاهلها.

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.text: Anna, are you afraid of bees?
